title: The Pi Building - Third
description: Harbor Operations & Deterrent Control. Rebuilt to match the structural bracing, red centerlines, and corridor alignment established in Floors 1-2. Bay-facing display wall runs the full south face -- this is where the sonic deterrent buoy controls live (Appendix G), and where the team can see on the display that the system is dark.
